content: sokol_gfx backends: GLES3/WebGL2, GL3.3 (GLCORE), D3D11, Metal, WebGPU, a 'dummy' no-op backend, and (new Dec 1 2025) an experimental Vulkan backend. Select exactly one backend at compile time via SOKOL_GLCORE/SOKOL_GLES3/SOKOL_D3D11/SOKOL_METAL/SOKOL_WGPU/SOKOL_VULKAN -- there is no automatic runtime fallback chain across backends; the app picks one at build time.
